liebermann.notes: From Coventry; f. 116 begins, after a now torn-away quire, ECf retr at 6a. Madan doubts that it once belonged to Cotton.

entries.text_de: Oxford Bodley Douce 139 aus Coventry19; f. 116, um 1290, beginnt nach einer jetzt fortgerissenen Lage ECf retr 6a, u. S. 631.
entries.text_en: Oxford, Bodley Douce 139, from Coventry19; f. 116, c. 1290, begins, after a gathering now torn away, ECf retr 6a, below, p. 631.

notes.text_de: Dass der Band einst Cotton gehörte, bezweifelt Madan Summary catal. of Bodl. n. 21713. Vgl. Liebermann Über Leges ECf. 127.
notes.text_en: That the volume once belonged to Cotton is doubted by Madan, Summary catal. of Bodl. no. 21713. Cf. Liebermann, Über Leges ECf. 127.

transcription.doubts: 'Bodley' is letter-spaced in print, apparently for justification; not marked as Sperrdruck.
